preconditions.description: The size of the array N must be between 1 and 20,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(arr[i]) <= 10 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each string in the array must have a length between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(arr, list) and all(isinstance(s, str) for s in arr)
preconditions.description: The input must be a list of strings.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '1' if palindromepair(arr, N) else stdout == '0'
postconditions.description: The output must be '1' if a palindrome pair exists, otherwise '0'.
